articles.title: Trump Announces 'AI Force' and AI Tsar, Calls Safety Warnings a 'Hoax'
articles.summary: President Trump says the U.S. will launch an 'AI Force' and appoint an AI tsar to keep America ahead of China. He calls AI safety fears a 'hoax,' but top AI leaders like Anthropic's Dario Amodei want slower, safer development.

articles.title: Congo Launches Ebola Vaccinations for Front-Line Workers in Bunia
articles.summary: Congo started vaccinating health workers against Ebola in Bunia, the epicenter of its deadliest outbreak ever. The Ervebo vaccine targets a different Ebola strain, but scientists hope it offers some protection. So far: 7,541 cases, 3,639 deaths.

articles.title: Bachelet Quits UN Race After Support Collapses in Straw Poll
articles.summary: Michelle Bachelet wanted to be the first woman to lead the UN in its 80-year history. After Friday's secret straw poll gave her just one encouraging vote, she dropped out.
